# User-supplied optional post-install attachment

MAS_AIO.bat is the exact file supplied by the project owner. It identifies itself as Microsoft Activation Scripts3.12; this copy changes the default menu dispatch. It is not certified as an unchanged upstream release. GPL-3.0 text is included in LICENSE; source is supplied unchanged here, with the original attribution retained in the batch file.

Bytes:761356. SHA-256:17f10848ae162dd6e68c0e19080474e043ecad3caba4b10a50368006d2788e90. It is never executed on the build host. Issued commands include it only when the authenticated issuer explicitly turns Run attached script On, on a compatible Windows client profile. The Windows worker uses the matching unattended HWID mode with edition changes disabled, after setup/readiness. This does not provide or certify a Windows license. Never silently change this file for already-issued commands.
